name: SYRAX
source: hand-audited from source code; regenerate when components change

components.purpose: ULTRON orb UI: Three.js orb, operations log feed, voice pipeline, brain panel, boot sequence.
components.state: React useState in components/Syrax.tsx (entries[] capped at 300, agent state, brains, voice flags); localStorage syrax.* for preferences
capabilities: render journaled events as feed entries
limitations: hardcoded HUD regions; no dynamic presentation engine
history/task_events/verifications replies are received but not drawn
failure_modes: WS offline → exponential reconnect, agent shown as booting

components.purpose: FastAPI app: /ws sessions (observers + command routers), /stt, /tts, /voice, /health; lifespan opens the journal, runs recovery, optional auto-resume.
inputs: task, answer, stop, reset, ping, history, task_events, verifications, resume, brains_*
outputs: hello{tools, interrupted, running, recent}, state, user echo, journaled wire events, history, task_events, verifications, notice, error, brains*
components.state: per connection: Session(id, closed, aux tasks); the task itself lives in Core
capabilities: multiple sessions observe the same task
reconnect replays the running task's events
origin check on WS and voice routes
limitations: no auth beyond Origin allow-list; binds 127.0.0.1
failure_modes: bad JSON → error event, session survives
command exception → error event, session survives

components.purpose: The single SYRAX entity: owns the agent and the running task, routes agent events through the journal, fans wire events to observers, resumes interrupted tasks.
inputs: submit(goal), cancel(), answer(text), reset(), resume(task_id), auto_resume()
components.state: agent, current Running{task_id, goal, session_id, asyncio.Task, steps[], unjournaled}, last state event
capabilities: task continues when all browsers disconnect
checkpoint after each tool step and at final
journal write failure → unjournaled flag, no fake success
auto-resume of RESUMABLE tasks when SYRAX_AUTO_RESUME=1
limitations: one task at a time; no queue scheduling
brain events from a running task are journaled only while current is set
failure_modes: sqlite error → task stays IN_PROGRESS, marked INTERRUPTED next boot

components.purpose: Durable execution journal: tasks, events, semantic checkpoints, verifications; transition table; crash recovery with reality checks; fan-out to subscribers.
dependencies: stdlib only: sqlite3, json, threading, asyncio, subprocess(git)
inputs: start_task, record(type,payload,task_id), checkpoint, record_verification, recover, resume_context, mark_resumed
outputs: queries: task, tasks, events, recent_events, checkpoints, verifications
components.state: one sqlite connection guarded by a threading.Lock; boot_id; recovered[]
limitations: no retention/compaction
only file edits are reality-checked; other tools UNCERTAIN
PENDING tasks are stored but not scheduled
tests: backend/syrax/test_journal.py (SIGKILL crash matrix, transition table, recovery, resume, fan-out)
failure_modes: JournalError on invalid transition/unknown task/terminal task → rolled back
crash inside recovery → whole txn lost, redone next boot

components.purpose: Evidence-based model of SYRAX itself: identity/version from git, structure from docs/system_map.json + repo introspection, behavior/failures/verifications from the journal, a capability registry (registered tools × journal evidence), runtime resources, derived weaknesses. Exposed as the self_inspect tool, WS self_model and GET /self, and the SELF panel.
dependencies: core providers: tool names, brains.describe, running task
outputs: JSON snapshot; self_inspect tool output (truncated at 6000 chars)
components.state: none (computed on demand; process start time for uptime)
components.persistence: none; reads docs/system_map.json and the journal
capabilities: capability status derived: VERIFIED / FAILING / NOT_TESTED / MISSING with uses, failures, confidence
None instead of invented values when git or the map is unavailable
limitations: GPU is not probed
system_map.json is hand-audited and must be regenerated when components change
no historical performance/latency metrics yet (journal has timestamps but nothing aggregates them)
does not yet feed an objectives engine
failure_modes: self_inspect before the core exists → tool error

components.purpose: Manus subclass that streams think/tool/result events through emit, checkpoints after each tool step, exports/imports working context for resume.
outputs: emit: state, think, tool_start{step}, tool_result{step,image?}, notice
components.state: OpenManus Memory (messages, trimmed to ~120), current_step, step_limit_hit, last_reply
components.persistence: none (context is snapshotted by the journal via export_context)
capabilities: chat mode ends turn without tools
MCP browser tools stay connected between tasks
limitations: max_steps 20
tool success is a heuristic on the result text (_succeeded)

components.purpose: LLM-compatible router over 10 providers with cooldown-based failover; emits brain failover/answered events.
capabilities: model listing and test per provider
limitations: only ask_tool is implemented (ask/ask_with_images are not)
listeners are global: all sessions see brain events

components.purpose: Long-term facts and recent exchanges injected into every system prompt; remember/recall/forget tools.
limitations: flat files; history now duplicates journal.tasks
failure_modes: history write failure is logged, task still SUCCESS

components.purpose: python_execute (non-blocking), str_replace_editor, desktop, remember/recall/forget, ask_human (web), self_inspect, terminate, browser_* (MCP).
components.persistence: workspace/ files and screenshots written by tools
limitations: python/browser/desktop side effects are not reality-checked after a crash

components.purpose: edge-tts TTS with metallic chain on the client; STT via Groq Whisper or local faster-whisper.
limitations: English only in practice

components.purpose: Runs real gates (py_compile, pytest, tsc, eslint, node test, isolated next build, diff scan) and records GREEN/BLOCKED with per-gate evidence in the journal.
outputs: report, exit code 0/1, verifications row + verification.completed event
capabilities: NOT_VERIFIED when a gate cannot run
next build on a scratch copy so live .next is untouched
limitations: performance gate has no benchmark yet (NOT_VERIFIED, optional)
no independent-review gate; review is done by the operator/agent

components.purpose: BaseAgent/ReActAgent/ToolCallAgent loop, LLM client, tool collection, config, loguru logging. Untouched since import.
limitations: no callbacks; SYRAX hooks by subclassing
tests: backend/tests/** (sandbox, browser MCP; not run by SYRAX gate)

components.purpose: syrax.sh starts backend (8765) and Next (3000) in separate process groups; systemd user service restarts on failure and opens the UI.
capabilities: refuse to start on busy ports
limitations: one instance per machine
failure_modes: either process exiting stops both; systemd restarts after 5 s
